name: Startup India
benefit: Tax exemption for 3 years, self-certification for 6 labour and 3 environmental laws, ₹10,000 crore Fund of Funds, fast-track patent filing
benefit_hindi: 3 saal tax chhoot, saraltata se compliance, Fund of Funds se paisa, tez patent filing

eligibility.description: Entity incorporated as private limited company, partnership firm, or LLP, working towards innovation and growth
eligibility.description_hindi: Private limited company, partnership firm, ya LLP jo innovation aur growth mein kaam kare
criteria: Entity incorporated no more than 10 years ago
Working towards innovation, development, or improvement of products/services
Not formed by splitting or restructuring an existing business

steps: Apply for tax exemption through income tax portal
Apply for Fund of Funds through registered AIFs
steps_hindi: Income tax portal se tax chhoot ke liye apply karein
Fund of Funds ke liye registered AIF se sampark karein

hindi_summary: Startup India mein naye business ko 3 saal tax chhoot, Fund of Funds se paisa, aur tez patent filing milti hai. startupindia.gov.in par register karein aur DPIIT Recognition lein.
